sloka: राजभावे नियोगः अयम् मम त्वत् विरहात् कृतः ।स अमात्य पौर नगरम् स्थितम् निहत कण्टकम् ॥४-१०-८॥
transliteration: rājabhāve niyogaḥ ayam mama tvat virahāt kṛtaḥ ।sa amātya paura nagaram sthitam nihata kaṇṭakam ॥4-10-8॥

translations.english: 'You alone are the king and worthy of reverence.I will be the same old brother carrying out my work as earlier. I held the responsibility of the state in your absence forced by the citizens and ministers. The kingdom has been kept stable with the enemies destroyed.
translations.hindi: हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ ! आप अपने बाणा से चाहें तो युद्ध में इन्द्रादि समस्त देवताओं को मार सकते हैं। फिर हे प्रभो! वालि की तो बिखात ही क्या है
